title: Spicy Shrimp and Jewel Toned Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Indian-inspired stir fry with succulent shrimp and a colorful medley of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Jewel Toned Bell Peppers, Toned Zucchini, and Peruvian Potatoes to the skillet.
Cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Camarones Seasoning Blend and stir to combine.
Return the cooked shrimp to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and seasoning.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
